$comment: Knowledge Engine — one out-of-process source scan payload (issue #19, M4). A scanner adapter reads only under its resolved, containment-checked root, honors the structural deny-list plus additive globs, and emits KB-record-shaped metadata plus per-file sha256 digests. Unsupported scan shapes become explicit diagnostics (UNKNOWN evidence), never guesses; licensed packages are metadata-only (identifiers, versions, counts, path pointers, license facts — never source, templates, assets or keys). The extract orchestrator re-validates every emitted record against the KB record schemas and the shared record-safety gate before anything is written.
title: Knowledge Engine — KB source scan payload

adapterId.$comment: The single M4 scanner adapter (adapters/magento-kb-source). One scan kind per payload.

version.$comment: Platform version observed from declarations (e.g. composer.json), if determinable.

capabilities.$comment: KB-1 records (kb-capability shape; the magento-platform kind emits recordType 'module' inventory records). Shapes are re-validated by the orchestrator — the adapter never bypasses the store's write-time gates.

uiComponents.$comment: KB-2 records (kb-ui-component shape; pagebuilder-native / secomm-uiwidget / hyva-ui kinds). Re-validated by the orchestrator.

relations.$comment: kb-relations-shaped edges (e.g. adaptedFrom UiWidget→Hyvä UI; neighborOf across the Page Builder editability-class boundary). Endpoint ids may reference records emitted by other scans of the same extract run — resolution happens at store ingest.

digests.$comment: sha256 per read file, keyed '<rootAlias>:<aliasRelativePath>' — the re-audit pinning vocabulary (digestKey convention). Records' observed.inputDigests reference these keys.

fileCount.$comment: Files actually opened (deny-listed and skipped files excluded).

deniedCount.$comment: Paths denied by the deny-list before read — DENIED_PATH_SKIPPED diagnostics carry the paths.

unknownShapes.$comment: Encountered declaration shapes the scanner could not parse deterministically — each carries an UNSUPPORTED_SHAPE diagnostic and UNKNOWN evidence.

sourceRef.$comment: Optional {kind, locator} source pointer; locator values must stay alias-relative.
